title: Sleeper Unit 09 manual static sprite construction failed quality gate
summary: Independently authored an original 128x216 static front-standing Unit09 sprite using 16 hand-planned opaque RGB colors and binary 0/255 alpha, complete arms/legs, visor, head-side modules, red wiring and an 09 shoulder mark. This was FROM BLANK PIXELS and is distinct from the separate reference-crop/palette exercise. Comparison with the supplied canonical sprite shows legs too short and stout, insufficiently layered torso plates and weak volumetric helmet construction. Technical PNG validity is not professional artistry; this remains a failing construction sketch. Next: correct hips/thigh/shin proportions and interlocking armor at 1x before animation or damage.
